sidenav_install_help_ios_step_3: Confirm the action to install Khartis on your device.
sidenav_install_help_chromium_step_1: On desktop, look for the install icon in the address bar.
sidenav_install_help_chromium_step_2: If needed, open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Install Khartis”.

sidenav_install_help_opera_step_2: Look for “Install app”, “Install”, or “Add to Home screen”.

sidenav_install_help_other_step_2: If no install action is available, that browser probably does not support Khartis PWA installation.

deck_debug_metric_fps_info: Frames rendered per second. If this drops during interactions, rendering or the machine is becoming the bottleneck.
deck_debug_metric_fps_state_good: Rendering is smooth. The map is handling the load well.
deck_debug_metric_fps_state_ok: Rendering is still okay. Watch the heaviest interactions.
deck_debug_metric_fps_state_warn: Visible slowdown. Rendering is starting to saturate.
deck_debug_metric_fps_state_bad: Rendering is slow. Look for a bottleneck in data, layers, or GPU work.
deck_debug_metric_cpu_info: Average CPU time per frame on the JavaScript and Deck side. Higher values mean layer and data preparation is getting expensive.
deck_debug_metric_cpu_state_good: CPU cost is low. JavaScript and Deck work stays light.
deck_debug_metric_cpu_state_ok: CPU cost is moderate. Nothing alarming yet.
deck_debug_metric_cpu_state_warn: CPU cost is high. Layer preparation may start limiting smoothness.
deck_debug_metric_cpu_state_bad: CPU is the bottleneck. Reduce recalculations, JS work, or layer count.
deck_debug_metric_gpu_info: Average GPU time per frame. A rise here means WebGL drawing or GPU composition is becoming the limiting factor.
deck_debug_metric_gpu_state_good: GPU cost is low. WebGL drawing stays light.
deck_debug_metric_gpu_state_ok: GPU cost is moderate. Watch heavy styles and layers.
deck_debug_metric_gpu_state_warn: GPU cost is high. WebGL rendering is starting to weigh in.
deck_debug_metric_gpu_state_bad: GPU is the bottleneck. Simplify drawing or composition.
